design_description: A clean and elegant champions-style jersey built around a minimalist white foundation with deep royal blue detailing. The design communicates prestige and celebration, fitting perfectly for a Campione Fantacalcio winner kit. The upper half stays intentionally clean, allowing the typography and crest to breathe, while the navy collar and sleeve cuffs frame the shirt with a classic football aesthetic. The defining feature is the lower-body graphic treatment: abstract blue paint-wave textures rise from the bottom hem like splashing water or ink, feeling dynamic but controlled. The centered Campione Fantacalcio 2025/2026 typography with cup icon reinforces the commemorative champions identity. Overall, the design sits between classic football elegance and modern artistic motion graphics — simple at first glance, but elevated through texture placement and balance.
